title: Wellington Doctoral Scholarship

compensation.value: $32,000 stipend annually plus tuition fees, for up to three years

about: Victoria University of Wellington offers Wellington Doctoral Scholarships for doctoral study, with three rounds a year. The current round closes 1 November 2026 at 4.30 pm; offers are made about six weeks after each closing date.
requirements: Normally a Bachelor's or Master's degree with academic distinction equivalent to a First Class Honours degree at a New Zealand university
Must be eligible, or reasonably expect to become eligible within three months, to enrol in a Doctoral degree at the university
Online application and all supporting documentation, including references, must be received by 4.30 pm on the closing date; late or incomplete applications are not accepted

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "eligible ... to enrol in a Doctoral degree at the university" -> "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"Bachelor's or Master's degree with academic distinction" (doctoral-level research study) -> "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."
